purpose: Improve how the five highest-impact Brain capabilities operate, reason, produce, correct, and execute.

topPriority.label: Headline Intelligence
topPriority.operatingRule: Generate headlines only after the CE article and Story Dossier are complete.
topPriority.reasoningRule: Use main actor + specific action + consequence from the dossier; reject word salad, copied structure, truncation, and source mismatch.
topPriority.correctionRule: If a headline fails, rerun Headline Dossier Builder with required actor/action/consequence fields before the Editor sees it again.
topPriority.executionRule: Produce at least five candidate headlines, score each against evidence overlap and natural grammar, then publish the first passing candidate.
topPriority.verificationMetric: headline pattern success rate and headline-source-overlap must improve on the next writing cycle.
topPriority.nextAction: Make headline repair the first writer repair pass, not a final polish pass.

lanes.operatingRule: Generate headlines only after the CE article and Story Dossier are complete.
lanes.reasoningRule: Use main actor + specific action + consequence from the dossier; reject word salad, copied structure, truncation, and source mismatch.
lanes.correctionRule: If a headline fails, rerun Headline Dossier Builder with required actor/action/consequence fields before the Editor sees it again.
lanes.executionRule: Produce at least five candidate headlines, score each against evidence overlap and natural grammar, then publish the first passing candidate.
lanes.verificationMetric: headline pattern success rate and headline-source-overlap must improve on the next writing cycle.

lanes.label: Writer Learning From Editor Patterns
lanes.operatingRule: The Writer reads pattern lessons before drafting, while the Story Dossier supplies facts.
lanes.reasoningRule: Treat editor decisions as craft lessons, not content to imitate.
lanes.correctionRule: Every repeated rejection becomes a pre-draft prevention rule for the Writer, Headline Editor, and Dossier Builder.
lanes.executionRule: Before each draft, apply the top three failing pattern rules from Writing Intelligence.
lanes.verificationMetric: first-pass acceptance and pattern success rates must rise without weakening editor gates.
lanes.nextAction: Turn the weakest pattern into the first required writer instruction for the next cycle.

lanes.label: Predictive Brain
lanes.operatingRule: Forecast degradation before it affects public output.
lanes.reasoningRule: Use trends across feed latency, source failures, dossier completeness, editor rejections, and article output.
lanes.correctionRule: When a metric trends down twice, create a preventive action instead of waiting for a public failure.
lanes.executionRule: Attach a next-check deadline and target metric to every preventive action.
lanes.verificationMetric: forecastSignals, preventedFailures, and post-action metric improvements.
lanes.nextAction: Create source/article/editor risk forecasts for the next rebuild cycle.

lanes.label: Story Dossier Builder
lanes.operatingRule: The Writer receives a structured dossier, not RSS snippets or raw publisher summaries.
lanes.reasoningRule: Classify who, what, when, where, official evidence, independent reports, contradictions, unknowns, and confidence before writing.
lanes.correctionRule: If topic drift appears, demote the draft and rebuild the dossier cluster before attempting another article.
lanes.executionRule: Collector and sub-dossier workers must feed tab-specific evidence into the main dossier before Writer selection.
lanes.verificationMetric: article-body-topic-drift, mixed-source-topic, and insufficient-full-article-facts must decline.
lanes.nextAction: Add a hard ready-for-writer gate requiring known facts, evidence classes, and topic-isolation score.

lanes.label: Cross-Subsystem Reasoning
lanes.operatingRule: No subsystem should diagnose in isolation when another subsystem may be the cause.
lanes.reasoningRule: Test causal chains: feed quality -> dossier quality -> writer quality -> editor acceptance -> public output.
lanes.correctionRule: When a downstream stage fails, inspect upstream telemetry before changing the downstream subsystem.
lanes.executionRule: Write a causal note into proof memory for every high-impact repair.
lanes.verificationMetric: causal links recorded and repeated failures reduced after upstream repair.
lanes.nextAction: Add causal scoring between feed reliability, dossier quality, headline quality, and article approvals.

sharedVerificationRule: Every high-impact improvement must name the metric it expects to improve, rerun after execution, and record whether the metric moved.
rollbackRule: If a change reduces public output, weakens editor gates, or increases topic drift/headline mismatch, revert that change and preserve the lesson as a failed experiment.
rule: Visible quality improves fastest when Headline Intelligence, Story Dossier Builder, Predictive Brain, Cross-subsystem Reasoning, and Writer/Editor Pattern Learning improve together.
